english.note: This is the all-purpose word, used for organisms and metaphorically for people who live off others.

examples.english: A parasite can live on another organism and survive by absorbing nutrients.
examples.traditional: 寄生蟲可以寄生喺其他生物身上，靠吸收養分生存。
